about_the_game:
Joth Fading is a souls-like, single-player, story-based, fantasy RPG that blends mythologies from around the world. Journey through two collapsing continents to the rescue gods. Uncover the secrets of the present and the mysteries of Rishi's past, that have been locked away by some unknown force.

In this demo, you'll get to fight Ra, the Sun God. Tired of aeons of thankless war, tired of holding back the Chaos single-handedly... all he wants is an end. To usher in the destruction of the universe, he plans to destroy the Last Forest. Humanity's last food source will burn, and there will be no one left to stop the incoming doom.

Ra is no pushover. Evade his attacks and find a way to break his shield of fire before he turns you to ash.

Game Story:

After ten years of deep meditation, Rishi awakens to a blasted planet. His only clue? A blinding pillar of light piercing the sun - a harbinger of cosmic destruction. Food, water, and even air are running out. The gods have been chained - some by demons, and others by their own indecision. Humanity is dying. Rishi must save his species, but it will all be for naught if he does not stop the "Jyothir Linga", an ever-expanding pillar of light that will consume earth and eventually, the entire universe.

Rescue the gods. Restore the world. Reach the sun, and save existence.

short_description: Joth Fading is a souls-like, story based RPG. Save humanity by completing your quests. Master the three combat styles that will help you best demons and gods alike. Traverse the world to find optional mysteries about the land. Beware! Any enemy can kill you with a well-placed blow. Stay alert.
